backup_protocol.core_principle: Never modify Cline original files without CARET MODIFICATION comment (no .cline backups; use git)
pre_checks: Is this a Cline original file?
Ensure git working tree is clean: 'git status'
Confirm recovery path: 'git checkout -- filename.ext' (or 'git restore filename.ext')

modification_rules.replacement: complete, never comment out old code
modification_rules.new_file_header: // CARET MODIFICATION: (required for new files in protected dirs)
